text:
maya: Quick proposal — decision tree for page vs ticket for GPU infra alerts. TL;DR: page only for sustained, high-impact events (cluster-wide capacity loss, multi-region network issue, SLO > severity-1); ticket for noisy single-node flaps. WIP below, need ops + SRE input.

alex: +1 on the principle. Can we define concrete thresholds? right now paging floods on ephemeral pod OOMs.

sre-lead: Suggested matrix: severity mapping -> action:
- Critical (SLO breach affecting >=10% of tokens or >2 regions) => page
- High (throughput drop >30% for 10m in primary region) => page
- Medium (node flaps / OOMs limited to <10% nodes sustained 5m) => ticket + auto-escalation if grows
- Low (single node transient) => ticket only

tasha: love the matrix. Also want grouping rules by cluster + model-version to avoid duplicates.

maya: proposing specific Prometheus rule samples:

```yaml
- alert: GPUClusterCapacityPressure
  expr: sum(gpu_idle_fraction{job="node_exporter"}) by (cluster) < 0.2
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    runbook: https://playbooks/redwood/gpu-capacity
```

maya: And an example noisy rule with cooldown/hysteresis:

```yaml
- alert: GPUNodeOOMBurst
  expr: increase(node_ooms_total[5m]) > 3
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: medium
  annotations:
    paging: "false"
```

alex: For grouping, set group_by: [cluster, region, model_version]. Also recommend `group_wait: 30s, group_interval: 5m, repeat_interval: 4h` for alerts that page.

sre-lead: Add cost/impact dimension: if alert would trigger spillover to higher-cost Dedicated nodes, treat as high.

tasha: propose mute windows during non-business-hours for low/medium alerts but with override for criticals. Example: mute: 23:00-06:00 local region for medium.

maya: runbook checklist for pages:
- confirm SLO impact (dashboards: https://grafana.company/gpu-health)
- check capacity per-region `kubectl get node -l gpu=true -o wide`
- identify model traffic spikes (ingress metrics)
- escalate to infra if more than 2 nodes in 2 regions affected

alex: small ops note — add automatic paging suppression for rolling upgrades initiated by deploy-bot with label `upgrade_in_progress=true`.

sre-lead: agree. Also let's add a test harness to fire synthetic alerts to test routing before rollouts.

tasha: timeline? I'd like to land an RFC by EOW and a canary in staging next week.

maya: I'll draft RFC and include the Prometheus/Grafana snippets + runbook. cc @oncall-bot to create a follow-up ticket.

oncall-bot: Created ticket RED-9876 "RFC: GPU alert decision matrix" assigned to maya, due 2026-03-25

alex: Thanks — will review RFC today. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all. Closing thread for now; will post RFC link here once created.
